infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MyTownServices needs camera access to let you take photos for your profile and service requests.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MyTownServices needs photo library access to let you upload images for your profile and service requests.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MyTownServices needs microphone access for audio features.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MyTownServices needs your location to show services available near you.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: MyTownServices needs to send you notifications for order updates and service alerts.
